description: This file defines the AlarmTableConfig class, which extends EntityTableConfig to configure and manage an alarm table component in an Angular application. It includes methods for fetching alarm data, displaying alarm details, managing alarm assignments, acknowledging, clearing, and deleting alarms, and configuring table columns and actions.

classes.name: AlarmTableConfig
classes.description: Angular class extending EntityTableConfig to manage alarm table functionalities, including data fetching, alarm actions, and UI interactions.

methods.name: fetchAlarms
methods.description: Fetches alarm data based on current mode and filter settings, returning an Observable of PageData<AlarmInfo>.

methods.name: showAlarmDetails
methods.description: Opens a dialog to display detailed information about a specific alarm.

methods.name: getAssigneeTemplate
methods.description: Generates HTML template string for displaying the alarm's assignee information.

methods.name: getAvatarBgColor
methods.description: Returns a background color for the user avatar based on the assignee's display name.

methods.name: openAlarmAssigneePanel
methods.description: Opens an overlay panel to assign or reassign an alarm's assignee.

methods.name: ackAlarms
methods.description: Acknowledges selected alarms, with confirmation dialogs and batch processing.

methods.name: clearAlarms
methods.description: Clears selected alarms, with confirmation dialogs and batch processing.

methods.name: deleteAlarms
methods.description: Deletes selected alarms after user confirmation.
